name: The Sunken Holds
summary: The deep-folk realm: a federation of clan-holds carved into the Stone Crown, arbitrated by the eldest hold. Fewer than twenty holds survived the Sundering; the federation is their answer to a broken world — law spoken and sworn, steel signed at the First Forge, doors kept shut on everything else.

government.title: Hall-Voice of Hallord (first among equals)
government.note: Each hold keeps its own Hall-voice; Hallord's arbitrates disputes between holds. No king has ever been crowned — the last attempt is a cautionary saga.

laws: Spoken law sworn on the First Forge — nothing written. The Glimmer is 'a lie the earth never made': outright ban, no exceptions in four millennia. Glimmerborn are cast out into the snow.

relations.note: Root against shaft; the spring root-treaties hold an uneasy peace.
Mining rights leased at the passes; both sides strictly honest about ore weights.
The Shapers' recent shaft-sealings trouble the clans.

history_notes: Predates the Concord; survived the Sundering behind closed doors.
The Humming Shaft sealed three years ago remains the federation's loudest silence.
adventure_hooks: A hold wants the Humming Shaft unsealed against Hall-Voice Borin's refusal; players are the neutral hands.
A surface-born dwarf is found Glimmerborn — the law says exile, the clan says mercy, and players witness the vote.
Root-treaty negotiations stall over a grove grown into a vault gallery; both sides hire players as surveyors.
